says: In next/, the L13 guard-bundle plan's Existing tools section has one line, for the new P19Guard.test-support.ts file, but the diff adds two new exported functions with no line there: phases (the host record's phase writer) and ready (the guard's ready-or-exit race), which decision 0587 says each need a line naming what was searched.
proof: docs/plan/quests/l13-guard-bundle-PLAN.md:142-148 holds a single bullet for next/apps/fabrika/e2e/node/P19Guard.test-support.ts, and the amendment (line 200 on) adds none; at 7d013e0189be558c8cd1281cd5fe21cd0e79d811 next/apps/fabrika/e2e/node/P19Launchd.test-support.ts:277 reads 'export const phases = Effect.fn("P19Host.phases")' and next/apps/fabrika/e2e/node/P19Guard.test-support.ts:222 reads 'export const ready = Effect.fn("P19Host.guardReady")'.
cost: A reader of the plan cannot tell whether an existing writer or race was looked for before these two were written, which is the check 0587 exists for; a later plan copying this one keeps the gap.
